title: workplan_read input (native surface)
description: Read one plan, optionally filtered to a phase/step, with its linked Markdown. A filtered read (D.1) returns the plan header, hashes, the selected phase/step and the dependency entries touching it; findings/notes only with includeNotes=true and Markdown only with includeMarkdown=true.

id.description: Workplan id; normalized to lowercase [a-z0-9-] (max 80) before use.

includeMarkdown.description: Include linked Markdown content (default true; default false when phaseId or stepId is given, D.1).

includeNotes.description: D.1 (approved 2026-09-30): with phaseId/stepId, also return reviewFindings and notes in the slice (default false). On an unfiltered read, false leaves the notes out (notesOmitted gives their count); absent or true returns the whole document.

x-shiori-core-surface: The standalone CLI/core surface additionally accepts optional 'workspaceRoot' (string); the native surface rejects it as an unrecognized key.
